# Blitz3D: Display

Opening 3D modes and querying driver capabilities.


Back to [[Blitz3D]] or the [[Command-Index]].

| Command | Returns | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [CountGfxModes3D](Blitz3D-Display#countgfxmodes3d) | Int |  |
| [GfxDriver3D](Blitz3D-Display#gfxdriver3d) | Int | Tells whether a graphics driver can draw 3D. |
| [GfxDriverCaps3D](Blitz3D-Display#gfxdrivercaps3d) | Int | Tells what the 3D driver is able to do. |
| [GfxMode3D](Blitz3D-Display#gfxmode3d) | Int | Tells whether the given mode from the list of modes can be used for 3D. |
| [GfxMode3DExists](Blitz3D-Display#gfxmode3dexists) | Int | Asks whether a resolution is available for 3D, before opening it with [Graphics3D](Blitz3D-Display#graphics3d). |
| [Graphics3D](Blitz3D-Display#graphics3d) | None | Opens the window, or full screen mode, that 3D programs are drawn in. |
| [Windowed3D](Blitz3D-Display#windowed3d) | Int |  |

### CountGfxModes3D

```blitzbasic
CountGfxModes3D  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

**Returns:** How many full screen modes the 3D driver offers. The numbers 1 to this value can be given to [GfxMode3D](Blitz3D-Display#gfxmode3d).

### GfxDriver3D

```blitzbasic
GfxDriver3D driver%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Tells whether a graphics driver can draw 3D.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `driver` | Int | required | Number of the driver, from 1 to the number that [CountGfxDrivers](BlitzBasic-Display#countgfxdrivers) reports. |

**Returns:** True if the driver can draw 3D pictures.

### GfxDriverCaps3D

```blitzbasic
GfxDriverCaps3D  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Tells what the 3D driver is able to do. The result is a version number: 100 means all of the standard Blitz3D features, 110 adds cube environment maps. Graphics3D has to have been called before.

**Returns:** 100 or 110.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* It always reports 100: there are no cube maps, the texture flag for them is accepted and ignored.

### GfxMode3D

```blitzbasic
GfxMode3D mode%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Tells whether the given mode from the list of modes can be used for 3D.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mode` | Int | required | Number of the mode, 1 to [CountGfxModes3D](Blitz3D-Display#countgfxmodes3d). |

**Returns:** True if the mode can show 3D.

### GfxMode3DExists

```blitzbasic
GfxMode3DExists width%, height%, depth%  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Asks whether a resolution is available for 3D, before opening it with [Graphics3D](Blitz3D-Display#graphics3d). It lets a game offer only the sizes that work.

```blitzbasic
If GfxMode3DExists(1024, 768, 32) Then
	Graphics3D 1024, 768, 32, 1
Else
	Graphics3D 640, 480, 0, 2
EndIf
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | Int | required | Width in pixels. |
| `height` | Int | required | Height in pixels. |
| `depth` | Int | required | Color depth in bits. |

**Returns:** True if a full screen mode of that size can be used.

### Graphics3D

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D width%, height%, depth%=0, mode%=0
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

Opens the window, or full screen mode, that 3D programs are drawn in. It has to be the first graphics command of a 3D program: every other 3D command fails until it ran. After it, the back buffer is the target of drawing and you draw one frame at a time with [RenderWorld](Blitz3D-World#renderworld) and [Flip](BlitzBasic-Display#flip).

| Mode | Behavior |
|---|---|
| 0 | Window while testing and full screen otherwise. This is the default. |
| 1 | Full screen. |
| 2 | Window. |
| 3 | Window whose size can be changed by the user; the picture is scaled to fit. |

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 640, 480, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 0, 0, 5

While Not KeyHit(1)
	TurnEntity cube, 1, 2, 0
	RenderWorld
	Flip
Wend
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | Int | required | Width of the picture in pixels. |
| `height` | Int | required | Height of the picture in pixels. |
| `depth` | Int | `0` | Color depth: 0 for the best, or 16, 24 or 32. Defaults to 0. |
| `mode` | Int | `0` | Window or full screen as in the table. Defaults to 0. |

**Differences and known gaps:**

* The depth is not used: pictures always have 32 bits per pixel, however much you ask for.

### Windowed3D

```blitzbasic
Windowed3D  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

**Returns:** True if the 3D picture can be shown in a window, which is the case on every desktop and always here. If it is False the program can only run full screen.
